items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did that mainly because I wanted to keep my connections in Washington with A.B. and all the people that I met down there on those panels.

ctx.x: Another place where I encountered you, and I think it’s an important thing to talk about, is your time at the National Endowment for the Arts on the music panel.

Yeah, oh man, right, those years. I did that mainly because I wanted to keep my connections in Washington with A.B. and all the people that I met down there on those panels. Plus I wanted to keep funds coming in to my program at Hartt and to the Artists Collective. So I was on the jazz panel, and then I was on another panel too that dealt with the more – I forgot the name of that committee.
Was that Expansion Arts? Were you on it?
